description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - meeting filter: in a long meeting, declare your name and topic keywords first, then listen; only when the ASR transcript hits a keyword does it light a banner with one TTS call and show the ~10-second pre-hit transcript buffer, while every non-hit segment only moves the heard counter. No speaker identification, no full-meeting recording, no persistence: the buffer keeps about 10 seconds and non-hits are discarded, and all session data lives in memory only and is wiped when the summary is confirmed or the agent closes.
name: meeting-filter
